build_attention_module: build a multi-head attention module with configurable heads, dim_head, dropout, and gate output
create_local_windowed_attention: create local windowed attention with radius-1 windowing and optional memory key-values
test_full_pairwise_repr_to_windowed: test converting a full pairwise representation to a windowed representation for atom attention
refactor_attn_bias_to_windowed: refactor a full attention bias matrix into a local windowed attention bias
summarize_attend_forward: summarize the Attend module forward method that performs scaled dot-product attention with optional softclamp and masking
